description: This file defines the Zend_Loader class, which provides static methods for loading PHP classes and files within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for autoloading classes, loading files, checking readability, and managing include paths, primarily to facilitate class autoloading and file inclusion in a Zend Framework project.

classes.name: Zend_Loader
classes.description: A class providing static methods for dynamic class and file loading, including autoloading, file inclusion, and include path management within the Zend Framework.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads a class from a PHP file based on the class name, supporting namespace and underscore-based structure, searching specified directories or the PHP include path.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads a PHP file, optionally searching additional directories and supporting include_once behavior.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if a filename is readable, considering include paths and Windows-specific path behaviors.

methods.name: explodeIncludePath
methods.description: Splits an include path string into an array of individual paths, handling stream schema cases.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Deprecated autoload method compatible with spl_autoload, triggers a warning, and attempts to load a class.

methods.name: registerAutoload
methods.description: Registers the autoload method with spl_autoload, optionally setting fallback autoloading.
